snippet.title: Momotaro and the Oni Island | Official Trailer - Wishlist now!
snippet.description:
Momotaro and the Oni Island | A match3-rpg game!

Join Momotaro on his journey to the Oni King. Match orbs to attack, exploit Fire, Water, and Plant weaknesses, fight alongside your companions, and choose your own path across the island.

Wishlist here:
https://steampowered.com/app/4939960/

Demo available:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5024200/
